description: Source code for managing radio capabilities, including initialization, enabling/disabling features, updating capability status, and handling supported driver capabilities within a radio management module.

methods.name: wld_rad_init_cap
methods.description: Initializes radio capabilities, setting their status and checking for null names.

methods.name: wld_rad_is_cap_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific capability is enabled for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_is_cap_active
methods.description: Checks if a specific capability is active for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_writeCapStatus
methods.description: Updates the capability status string of the radio.

methods.name: s_writeCapEnable
methods.description: Updates the enable status string of the radio capabilities.

methods.name: wld_rad_updateCapabilities
methods.description: Updates the list of available capabilities and their current status.

methods.name: wld_rad_setCapabilityIndex
methods.description: Sets the enable/disable status of a specific capability.

methods.name: s_setEnabled_pwf
methods.description: Callback to set enabled capabilities based on a string input.

methods.name: wld_rad_get_capability_index
methods.description: Returns the index of a capability given its name.

methods.name: _RadCaps_Enable
methods.description: Enables a specific capability via callback.

methods.name: _RadCaps_Disable
methods.description: Disables a specific capability via callback.

methods.name: _RadCaps_DebugPrint
methods.description: Prints all capabilities and their statuses for debugging.

methods.name: wld_rad_findSuppDrvCap
methods.description: Checks if a driver capability is supported for a given band.

methods.name: wld_rad_addSuppDrvCap
methods.description: Adds a supported driver capability to a band.

methods.name: wld_rad_getSuppDrvCaps
methods.description: Retrieves supported driver capabilities for a band.
